origins.section: A Model Written in Mixed Units Spreads Its Numbers Over Many Powers of Ten
Rescaling Multiplies a Row, a Column or the Objective, and Leaves the Plan Unchanged
HiGHS Can Scale the Objective and Bounds for You, Not the Matrix

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-warnings: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-warnings: 'the model is badly scaled whether or not a warning appears' and 'A model without warnings is not a well-scaled model; the ranges are the measure.' 1e-2 to 1e9 is eleven powers of ten.
recorded.prompt:q-column: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-column: 'Replacing a variable l by l = l'/r multiplies its coefficient in every row and in the objective by 1/r, and its bounds by r.' Here fill = fill_kl/(1/1000), so r = 1/1000: coefficients x1000, bounds /1000.
recorded.prompt:q-user-scale: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-user-scale: Summary: 'user_objective_scale silenced the warning; the 10^9 stayed.' Also: 'The matrix line still reads [10^-1, 10^9].'

recorded.prompt:q-warnings:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-warnings:a: 'HiGHS printed no warning about it' for the 1e9 in the matrix. HiGHS does not warn about every out-of-range number.
recorded.prompt:q-warnings:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-warnings:b: The 'objective in $k' step had small costs and no warning, yet the page calls it unscaled: 'A model without warnings is not a well-scaled model.'
recorded.prompt:q-warnings:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-warnings:d: The TIGHT model has costs up to 4,374 and is presented as well scaled: 'Every span is below 10^5.'
recorded.prompt:q-column:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-column:b: This is the reverse of the column rule (coefficients x1/r, bounds x r) with r = 1/1000.
recorded.prompt:q-column:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-column:c: The column rule says the coefficients and bounds do change.
recorded.prompt:q-column:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-column:d: Rescaling 'leaves the set of allowed plans, and the best plan, exactly as they were'. A column change does not touch the right-hand sides.
